description: Compares one guided gym session with its plan: maps the manual laps (as in get_workout_laps) to exercises, sets and rests and reports planned vs actual. Works for push_strength_guide and push_workout_guide sessions. The plan is read from the lap labels; pass the pushed exercises as `plan` to also check against them. baselineHr is the HR of lap 1 (the first prep), not resting HR. Result: status (ok | no-laps | no-guide-labels | unknown-label-format), reliable, note, checks, exercises (prep, sets, rests rows; columns in `cols`), deviations [{ code, basis, ex, plan, laps, detail }] (e.g. missing-set, extra-set, rest-short, ended-early, order-differs, missing-exercise). A rest row's peak is the rest lap's max HR and end its min HR (optical HR lags 20-30 s). reliable is false when checks has anything but no-heart-rate or the laps break the guide's step order; the mapping is then best effort and note says why. With restMode countdown a rest lap lasts exactly its target, so extra rest is not measurable.

plan.description: Optional: the exercises array given to push_strength_guide or push_workout_guide, as-is (name, sets, restSec are read).

workoutKey.description: 24-hex id from list_workouts; anything else fails with not-found.

name: compare_workout_to_plan
title: Compare workout to plan
